subject: science
domain: Heredity: Inheritance and Variation of Traits

items.prompt:
Asexual reproduction involves how many parents?
A) One
B) Two
C) Three
D) Four

steps: Asexual reproduction uses a single parent.

items.prompt:
Offspring from asexual reproduction are:
A) Genetically identical to the parent
B) Always different
C) Made by two parents
D) Nonliving
items.answer: A) Genetically identical to the parent

steps: Asexual offspring are clones of the parent.

items.prompt:
Sexual reproduction produces offspring that:
A) Are identical clones
B) Show genetic variation
C) Have no genes
D) Come from one parent

steps: Two parents' genes combine, creating variation.

items.prompt:
A strawberry plant makes identical new plants from runners. This is:
A) Sexual reproduction
B) Asexual reproduction
C) A mutation
D) Photosynthesis

steps: One parent and identical offspring indicate asexual reproduction.

items.prompt:
Two dogs have a litter of puppies that all look slightly different. This is explained by:
A) Asexual reproduction
B) Sexual reproduction mixing two parents' genes
C) No reproduction
D) Identical cloning
items.answer: B) Sexual reproduction mixing two parents' genes

steps: Sexual reproduction combines two parents' genes, producing variation.

items.prompt:
Which is an advantage of sexual reproduction?
A) It is always faster
B) It creates variation that helps survival in changing conditions
C) It makes perfect clones
D) It needs only one parent
items.answer: B) It creates variation that helps survival in changing conditions

steps: Variation helps populations survive changing conditions.

items.prompt:
Why might a population that reproduces sexually survive a new disease better than one that reproduces asexually?
A) Sexual reproduction makes identical offspring
B) Variation means some individuals may resist the disease and reproduce
C) Asexual populations are always varied
D) Disease cannot affect either
items.answer: B) Variation means some individuals may resist the disease and reproduce

steps: Genetic variation raises the chance that some individuals resist the disease.

items.prompt:
Which correctly pairs a reproduction type with its result?
A) Asexual: genetic variation
B) Sexual: identical clones
C) Asexual: identical offspring from one parent
D) Sexual: one parent, no variation
items.answer: C) Asexual: identical offspring from one parent

steps: Asexual reproduction yields identical offspring from one parent.
